messages:
maria_cs: FYI - OrionHealth pilot just flagged an availability dip on Dedicated (us-west-2) and p95 on /generate embeddings creeping above our commitment. Customer check-in in ~3w, they're worried about search UX. Need a quick ops + CS + sales plan and proposed customer note.

kevin_eng: Thanks Maria. I'm pulling the slow traces and checking warmup metrics. Initial read shows increased tail latency from a regional node pool during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Could be autoscale lag + cache pressure.

raj_ops: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/dedicated/orion-embeddings-slo — availability 99.88% over 7d, p95=360ms (commit 250ms). Posting anomaly timeline.

cs_bot: Alert: slo_check/orion_embeddings breached p95 threshold on 2026-03-19T02:41Z - runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/slo-investigation

sophie_sales: If we surface this in renewal materials without a fix, risk increases. Recommend CS propose a goodwill offset and a technical mitigation plan to present in the next call. Finance ok with one-off credits under $5k with manager approval.

lina_cs_manager: Suggested immediate play: 1) Eng triage + short-term mitigations (pre-warm tweak, lower batch max) 2) CS draft empathetic comms + include usage evidence and timeline 3) Ops produce before/after metric screenshots and link to runbook 4) Sales align renewal messaging and optional credit amount. Owners?

maria_cs: I'll own the comms draft and collect customer reaction. Can someone confirm the expected ETA for a short-term mitigation? "short-term" defined as <=48h.

kevin_eng: If it's config we can deploy canary in ~4h and roll fully in ~12h assuming no regressions. If it's infra autoscale tuning, might be ~36h. Running narrow query to confirm source buckets:

```
# count of requests by node during spike window
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embeddings",le="0.5"}[30m])) by (node)
```

I'll post traces and a small PR for batching changes shortly.

raj_ops: Pre-change baseline exported and attached to account doc (internal link). I'll schedule a metric snapshot post-deploy and pin the dashboard panels for CS.

maria_cs: Draft comms plan (short): 
- Acknowledge the variance and impact
- Share that Eng has a short-term mitigation in flight and expected ETA
- Offer goodwill offset per internal credit tiers and invite them to a technical review after metrics are stable
Will post draft copy in this thread once canary shows improvement.

sophie_sales: For offset recommendation: their current monthly spend is ~$2.6k. Lina, what credit tier would you propose for a perf variance in this band?

lina_cs_manager: Internal guidance: availability 99.999.95 -> 5% credit; 99.799.9 -> 10% credit. For p95 breaches with short mitigation and no sustained downtime, we usually propose a 5% goodwill offset plus a technical remediation note in the renewal package.

kevin_eng: Opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/pull/2799 — reduces batch_max to 48 and tweaks prewarm. Can canary in staging then us-west-2. Tagging @eng-oncall for review.

cs_bot: Canary job started: deployment/orion-embeddings-canary - build 20260319-58. Monitoring panels are live.

maria_cs: Great — once canary completes, I'll get a screenshot and draft text. Want the message to be transparent but reassure them we're tracking and have a timeline.

raj_ops: Canary metrics (1h): p95 down from 360ms -> 240ms in canary nodes. Availability for the canary slice stable at 99.99%. I'll attach the permalink after retention propagate.

maria_cs: That looks promising. Draft comms (internal):
"Hi team — quick update: we observed a latency variance on embeddings which impacted some search flows. Engineering deployed a targeted mitigation and early canary results show improvement (p95 reduced to ~240ms). We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with full telemetry in 24h. As a goodwill gesture we propose a 5% credit for this month. Please let us know if you'd like a short technical walkthrough"

sophie_sales: LGTM. Send me a copy before sending externally so we can align renewal talking points. Also capture credit approval path in the account notes.

lina_cs_manager: I'll approve the 5% credit request and mark renewal risk as "mitigated pending 24h stability". Schedule a follow-up with customer after 48h to review metrics and next steps.

maria_cs: Added note to account health tracker + renewal pack. I'll schedule follow-up call for two days out.

kevin_eng: Will keep monitoring. If we see any regression, will open a rollback and escalate.

maria_cs: Thanks all 91: we'll reconvene after 24h of stable metrics and finalize the external note.
